topics.topic: ProofResult identity when binding statuses change
questions: When mutable binding status changes the answer for the same flow version, is each ProofResult a snapshot identified by its result and proof-time dependencies, is one mutable result associated with the version, or is the result required to remain fixed?
Is a ProofResult fixed solely by flow_version_id, or may the same flow version produce different results as referenced binding statuses change; if it may change, what facts distinguish the results?

quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
judgement.why: The change did not touch M17 or make ProofResult identity newly consequential.

topics.topic: Scope of corpus cases executed by an explicit try
questions: Does an explicit try execute the whole current corpus, one named case, or a caller-selected subset?
Does one try request execute the implementation against the whole current corpus, one named case, or a caller-selected set of cases?

quotes: | try an implementation | agent | trial evidence per case | sandbox violation, timeout, contract violation are failures, never success |
judgement.why: The change did not touch the explicit try action or make its corpus scope newly consequential.

topics.topic: Behavior of an explicit try against an empty corpus
questions: Does an explicit try against an empty corpus refuse, or succeed while creating no TrialExecution records?

topics.topic: Canonical identity used to select and reference an EffectAttempt
questions: What identity does the resolve-unknown action and every reference use to select one EffectAttempt?

topics.topic: Durable association of a Run with its exact FlowActivation
questions: How does a run durably identify the exact FlowActivation under which it started, especially if the same version is activated again before a later draft-write node executes or the run is recovered?

topics.topic: Recording the requester of read-only flow activation
questions: Where is the owner or agent who requested a read-only activation recorded, separately from the kernel that performed the automatic activation?

topics.topic: Repair-slot selection and visibility of implementation bodies and evidence
questions: Which product action selects the repair slot and exposes its implementation and evidence, and does ordinary function inspection expose implementation bodies or evidence outside that one-slot repair context?

topics.topic: Run and EffectAttempt state transitions during in-flight cancellation
questions: When cancellation arrives while an EffectAttempt is in flight, when does the Run become `cancelled`, and may that attempt later transition to `applied`, `not_applied` or `unknown`?

topics.topic: Whether invalid flow inputs prevent Run creation or produce a failed Run
questions: When supplied flow inputs do not fit the active flow version’s input ports, is the request refused before a Run is minted, or is a failed Run and trace created?
